safety_rules: Relay may reference OpenClaw paths and safe commands.
Relay must not modify OpenClaw without explicit user approval.
Relay must not run destructive commands.
Market, crypto, equity, IPO, and business-trend workflows are research/reporting only.
No investment advice, buy/sell recommendations, guaranteed outcomes, or financial predictions.
PaperForge is fake money only: no wallet, no private keys, no swaps, no real money.
